title: Raising H.illucnes: A Protocol
protocol: Place the larvae in a 1m^3 box pre-filled with dirt.
Feed the larvae specific food 3-4 times a day at intervals of 2-3 hours.
Continue feeding until the larvae become pupae.
Increase the amount of food when the larvae transition to pupae.
Change the environment for adult emergence by adding water once pupae become adults.
Provide a mating environment with water after adults emerge.
Retrieve newly made larvae after adults have mated.
